core_condition: at least one measured effect recorded in observed_effects (live test moved to team integration phase)

evidence.rationale: Prospect theory (Kahneman & Tversky 1979, Econometrica; Nobel 2002); cumulative version 1992 estimated λ≈2.25. Meta-analysis of ~600 λ estimates across ~150 studies (Brown, Imai, Vieider & Camerer, JEL) finds mean λ≈1.8–2.1. Cross-country moderator work (Mrkva et al. 2020) finds the effect present across samples with real heterogeneity. Boundary conditions kept as record caveats: attenuates on small stakes (Ert & Erev 2013); coefficient shifts with decision context (Walasek & Stewart 2015).

product_applicability.rationale: Five implementations specified with at-scale reference products: Duolingo (streak + Streak Freeze), Amazon Prime (cancellation inventory), Starbucks Rewards (expiring stars). Covers Ventora's priority artifacts: paywall, cancellation flow, retention push.

measurability.rationale: Every implementation maps to an Amplitude-reachable metric: trial_to_paid_cvr, cancel_save_rate, d7/d30 retention, reactivation-in-expiry-window. No new infrastructure required.

orthogonality.rationale: Managed overlap, documented in relations: EN-03 endowment is theoretically downstream (giving up an owned good is coded as loss) — whether EN-03 is a peer L1 or an L2 effect is deferred to DOS-EN-03. SC-06 scarcity operates partly as loss-of-opportunity (hybrid noted).

safety.rationale: Adjacent to the most regulated dark patterns (fake urgency/scarcity, cancellation obstruction — EU and FTC enforcement targets). Boundary is definable and encoded as block-severity hard rules (real_loss_only, no_confirm_shaming, no_data_hostage, panic_cap, precondition_gate) plus the boundary test. Residual risk moderate because misuse is commercially tempting — hence 2, not 3.

dissent: Gal & Rucker, 'The Loss of Loss Aversion' (Journal of Consumer Psychology, 2018, DOI 10.1002/jcpy.1047): argues the principle is overgeneralized — in some paradigms losses do not loom larger than gains, and several classic demonstrations admit alternative explanations (inertia, status quo). Does not overturn the meta-analytic core but disciplines application: we claim the mechanism where accumulated, self-relevant value is at stake, and we measure rather than assume (see core_condition).
